headlines.headline: DOJ criminal probe deepens Clippers' Kawhi Leonard saga weeks after record league penalty
headlines.detail: Federal prosecutors in the Eastern District of New York are criminally investigating the same endorsement arrangement that cost the Clippers five first-round picks, a $30M fine, and a one-year ban for owner Steve Ballmer.

headlines.headline: Josh Allen accounts for 5 TDs as Bills christen new $2.1B stadium with 41-31 win over Lions
headlines.detail: Allen threw three TD passes and ran for two more Thursday night in the first regular-season game at Highmark Stadium; Bills WR DJ Moore (AC joint sprain) is questionable for Week 3.

headlines.headline: No. 1 Texas headlines loaded Week 3 as No. 2 Georgia travels to Arkansas
headlines.detail: Texas enters Week 3 ranked No. 1 at 2-0. Georgia (2-0), a 24.5-point favorite, visits Arkansas (1-1) Saturday at noon ET on ABC.

headlines.headline: Senate advances Protect College Sports Act 74-24 as NCAA eligibility chaos persists
headlines.detail: The bipartisan bill sets federal guardrails on NIL amid a federal judge's injunction letting a nationwide class of Division I athletes keep playing a fifth season pending litigation.
